newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: U.S. fighter jet crashes off west coast of S.Korea.
newsitem.headline: U.S. fighter jet crashes off west coast of S.Korea.

text.p: A U.S. fighter jet carrying two pilots crashed off South Korea's west coast on Sunday during a training mission, a U.S. Air Force spokesman said on Monday.
The South Korean and U.S. military were searching for the plane, said spokesman Bruce Alexander.
"We are investigating the incident, but have not yet found the pilots or the jet," he said, adding that it was still unclear what caused the crash. He declined to identify the missing pilots.
Two F/A-18 jets from the U.S. base in Iwakuni, Japan, were on a training mission when the one plane went down, he said. The second jet returned to the U.S. Air Force base at Osan, south of Seoul.
The South Korean air force and navy are searching the sea during the day while the U.S. navy conducts the search at night, said the spokesman.
